name: Rainbow Childrens Medicare Ltd.
about: Rainbow Children's Medicare Limited operates a multi-specialty pediatric, obstetrics, and gynecology hospital chain in India. The company offers medical and healthcare services to children and women. It also provides pediatric services under brand Rainbow Children's Hospital which include newborn and pediatric intensive care; pediatric multi-specialty services; and pediatric quaternary care, such as multi-organ transplantation. In addition, the company offers women care services under Birthright brand that comprise perinatal care services, such as routine and complex obstetric care, multi-disciplinary fetal care, perinatal genetic and fertility support, and a range of gynecology treatments, as well as operates private pediatric DNB (Diplomate of National Board) training program offering postgraduate and fellowship opportunities to train future healthcare professionals. verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~26% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~13% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
PE of 44 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 57), though that is a short history to judge by.
Since 2023, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 10% a year while PE moved 45 → 44.
